fields.after: Use it when you need AI-assisted design creation or edits inside Canva, and check permissions plus brand fidelity on one small workflow first.

changes.title: Figma agent

fields.after: An agent inside Figma Design for generating and editing layouts, applying connected libraries, and getting design feedback.

fields.after: Try one bounded layout edit with a connected library, then verify component use, hierarchy, and access scope.

entry.description: A set of agent skills for producing images, video, audio, textures, skyboxes, and 3D assets through the Scenario MCP, with separate expert tools for Blender, Maya, ZBrush, Unreal, and Unity.
entry.recommendation: Source-reviewed; not yet team-tested. Use it for one small branded asset task, such as a single image or 3D concept, before expanding to a wider production workflow.
entry.setup: Not stated; check whether the MCP or local DCC tool path fits your workflow

changes.evidence: Scenario MCP server, and each family folder's README records how it was built and how far it was verified. Skills follow the Agent Skills format. Install Everything for Scenario. changes.title: Seenry Skills

fields.before: A five-skill design workflow covering reference research, design direction, motion, assets, branding, presentations, implementation, and rendered review.
fields.after: A five-skill design workflow that researches real screens, measures references, explores compositions, and verifies work with evidence from seenry MCP.

fields.before: The package connects reference evidence to actual design decisions and verification. Start with one skill because the full suite introduces a substantial workflow of its own.
fields.after: Start with one skill, such as reference research or review, before adopting the full workflow.

changes.evidence: explainers studied from real references, rendered frame by frame, with designed sound and sourced claims What makes it different It looks before it designs. With Seenry MCP the agent searches a library of more than 100,000 captured app screens and nearly 2,000 websites, matched by category ("analytics hero", "payments pricing") as well as by name.

changes.title: Agentic QA boilerplate

entry.title: Agentic QA boilerplate
entry.description: A Playwright-based QA workflow that covers shift-left planning, in-sprint testing, KATA automation, regression, and go or no-go review.
entry.recommendation: Source-reviewed; not yet team-tested. Use it for one bounded QA flow, then confirm the handoff and review steps fit your team’s test process.
entry.setup: Not stated; install and run the project setup for the chosen agent stack
